name: SwiftEngineer Pi Distribution
description: A custom distribution of the Pi coding agent: the SwiftEngineer default harness plus the token-efficient MCP adapter.

packages.name: @swiftengineer/pi-harness
packages.description: Default SwiftEngineer agent harness: compact prompt, tool policy, task/subagents, search, ls/find, AST, todos, ask.

packages.name: pi-mcp-adapter
packages.description: Token-efficient MCP adapter: access every MCP server through one ~200-token proxy tool with lazy connections.

packages.name: pi-web-access
packages.description: Web search and content extraction: web_search (OpenAI/Brave/Parallel/Tavily/Exa/Perplexity/Gemini with fallback chains), fetch_content (URLs, GitHub repos, YouTube, PDFs), get_search_content.

packages.name: pi-powerline-footer
packages.description: Powerline-style segmented footer for the Pi TUI: cwd/branch, context %, tokens/cost, model • thinking • provider, rendered as color-blocked segments with powerline separators.

packages.name: pi-hashline-edit-pro
packages.description: Helps models patch files more accurately

packages.name: @czottmann/pi-automode
packages.description: Claude Code-style auto mode guardrail: intercepts agent tool calls before execution and blocks unsafe actions via permission deny rules, deterministic hard-deny checks, and a conservative classifier.
